integrity: Reproducible exact finite face-poset matching and complete directed-Hasse acyclicity certificates, checked by the packaged verifier; independently recomputed simplicial boundary ranks over GF(2).
scientific_limitations: Finite complete-case classification, not a proof for arbitrary graph orders, powers or cut parameters. The GF(2) computation alone does not prove integral homotopy. Priority and bibliographic completeness are not independently established.
scientific_scope: Integral homotopy types of total three-cut complexes of the third powers of the 13-, 14-, and 15-cycles, and only these three graph orders.
title: The first three unresolved third-power-cycle total three-cut complexes
